description: A Django-based Python module implementing a RecipeSearch class for filtering and searching recipes with various criteria, including full-text search, keyword, food, rating, and date filters.

classes.name: RecipeSearch
classes.description: A class providing complex filtering, sorting, and full-text search capabilities for recipes within a Django application.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes RecipeSearch with request and parameters, setting up search preferences and filters.

methods.name: get_queryset
methods.description: Builds and returns a filtered, ordered queryset of recipes based on initialized parameters.

methods.name: _sort_includes
methods.description: Checks if specific sort fields are included in the current orderby list.

methods.name: _build_sort_order
methods.description: Constructs the orderby list based on parameters like random, recent, new, or user-specified sort order.

methods.name: string_filters
methods.description: Applies text-based filters to the queryset, including full-text and trigram searches.

methods.name: _cooked_on_filter
methods.description: Filters recipes based on last cooked date.

methods.name: _viewed_on_filter
methods.description: Filters recipes based on last viewed date.

methods.name: _created_on_filter
methods.description: Filters recipes based on creation date.

methods.name: _updated_on_filter
methods.description: Filters recipes based on last update date.

methods.name: _created_by_filter
methods.description: Filters recipes created by a specific user.

methods.name: _new_recipes
methods.description: Filters for recipes created within a recent timeframe.

methods.name: _recently_viewed
methods.description: Filters recipes based on recent view logs.

methods.name: _favorite_recipes
methods.description: Filters recipes based on favorite or times cooked counts.

methods.name: keyword_filters
methods.description: Filters recipes based on associated keywords with logical operators.

methods.name: food_filters
methods.description: Filters recipes based on ingredients/foods with logical operators.

methods.name: unit_filters
methods.description: Filters recipes based on ingredient units.

methods.name: rating_filter
methods.description: Filters recipes based on average ratings.

methods.name: internal_filter
methods.description: Filters recipes based on internal flag.

methods.name: book_filters
methods.description: Filters recipes based on associated books.

methods.name: step_filters
methods.description: Filters recipes based on step IDs.

methods.name: build_fulltext_filters
methods.description: Constructs full-text search filters and annotations.

methods.name: build_text_filters
methods.description: Builds simple text filters for search.

methods.name: build_trigram
methods.description: Constructs trigram similarity filters for fuzzy search.

methods.name: _makenow_filter
methods.description: Filters recipes missing a certain number of ingredients, considering onhand and substitutes.

methods.name: __children_substitute_filter
methods.description: Static method returning foods that are children of foods on hand and set as substitutes.

methods.name: __sibling_substitute_filter
methods.description: Static method returning foods that are siblings of foods on hand and set as substitutes.
